title: Geniee Exchange Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Geniee Exchange adapter

partnerId.description: Supply partner integration ID issued by Geniee

placementId.description: Ad slot name chosen by the supply partner, unique within that partner. Alphanumerics, hyphen and underscore, at most 40 characters. Matched case-insensitively, so Sidebar and sidebar name the same slot. Only needed when the partner wants its reports split per slot
